description: This file is a CodeMirror addon that implements auto-closing and surrounding of brackets, quotes, and related editing behaviors.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves configuration options for bracket auto-closing behavior based on user settings or defaults.

methods.name: ensureBound
methods.description: Ensures key bindings for bracket characters are set.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Creates a handler function for a specific bracket character.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration for auto-closing brackets based on cursor mode.

methods.name: handleBackspace
methods.description: Handles backspace key to delete matching brackets if appropriate.

methods.name: handleEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key to insert new lines with proper indentation and spacing.

methods.name: moveSel
methods.description: Moves the cursor selection by a specified direction.

methods.name: contractSelection
methods.description: Contracts a selection to a single position.

methods.name: handleChar
methods.description: Handles input of bracket characters for auto-surrounding or skipping.

methods.name: charsAround
methods.description: Gets characters around the cursor to determine if auto-surround should occur.

methods.name: stringStartsAfter
methods.description: Checks if a string token starts after a given position.
